title: Product naming standards
summary: A demonstration framework for creating product names that remain coherent, distinctive and usable across records and communications.
contentNotice: Demonstration content for Atlas interface development; not final MOSCATELLI policy.

blocks.text: A product name should be distinctive enough to identify the object while remaining consistent across editorial, operational and commercial contexts.

items: Easy to read and pronounce in the principal operating languages
Distinct from an existing product or project name
Appropriate to the product rather than dependent on temporary campaign language
Usable in internal records without ambiguity

blocks.text: Development names may be practical and temporary. A final product name should only replace them once the change can be reflected consistently across the relevant records.

blocks.label: Consistency
blocks.text: Avoid allowing different teams to use competing names for the same product. If a name changes, the previous reference should remain traceable.

steps.title: Check the existing catalogue
steps.text: Confirm that the proposed name does not create an avoidable collision.

steps.title: Review meaning and use
steps.text: Consider pronunciation, connotation and how the name appears in editorial and operational contexts.

steps.title: Approve once
steps.text: Record the final decision and update dependent references from a single source of truth.
